text: 南向资金今日净卖出7.78亿元。港股通（沪）方面，腾讯控股、阿里巴巴-W分别获净卖出9.05亿港元、7.01亿港元；净买入额居首，金额为13.22亿港元；港股通（深）方面，腾讯控股、阿里巴巴-W分别获净卖出12.83亿港元、9.84亿港元；净买入额居首，金额为9.03亿港元。
text_en: Southbound capital recorded a net sell-off of 778 million yuan today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tencent Holdings and Alibaba-W saw net sells of HK$905 million and HK$701 million, respectively; the top net buy amounted to HK$1.322 billion. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Tencent Holdings and Alibaba-W recorded net sells of HK$1.283 billion and HK$984 million, respectively; the top net buy amounted to HK$903 million.
